messages:
elaine_cs: Quick ping on PineBridge onboarding — their p95 latency jumped to ~350ms after the last model rollout (mpt-7b). Cost per 1k tokens is creeping up, and they flagged renewal questions. I sketched a lightweight mitigation: try an int4 compact for short prompts + hybrid routing to keep tail latency down. Anyone see obvious downsides?

miguel_se: +1 to trying compact for short queries. Do we have metrics on how many requests are <40 tokens?

asha_cse: I pulled a 24h sample from their integration: ~62% of calls are <= 32 tokens, lots of short classification calls. Renewal risk if we don't cut cost/latency.

riley_ml: That distribution makes hybrid routing a good candidate. Quick thought: int4 quant on our compact model may add small quality drop on edge cases (rare long-context summaries), but for short calls it's usually fine.

elaine_cs: Good — client uses short calls for intent/labels mostly, long summaries are low volume. Can we propose a staged rollout?

riley_ml: Suggested rollout snippet for ops/console: 
```
routing: 
  - if tokens <= 40: model: redwood-compact-int4-v1 
  - else: model: mpt-7b-v3 
canary: 10% traffic for 1h -> 25% for 4h -> 100% if no regressions
metrics: p95_latency, token_cost, semantic-accuracy(on sample prompts)
```

miguel_se: Love that. For semantic-accuracy we should run 200 random short prompts from their corpus through both models and compare F1 or embedding-similarity. I can prep that harness.

asha_cse: I'll message the PineBridge PM to get approval for a short canary window. We should also add a prefix cache for frequent queries; their top 20 templates are ~30% of volume.

elaine_cs: Good call on caching — that reduces both p95 and cost. Riley — any infra gotchas for deploying compact-int4 in Dedicated vs Hosted?

riley_ml: For Dedicated there's a quant-friendly path; memory footprint is lower so concurrency improves. Hosted is fine but we may need to pin GPU type for predictable latency. No infra blockers.

deploy-bot: Deployment checklist created: https://deploys.redwood.internal/rollouts/1835001234 (canary job queued) :white_check_mark:

miguel_se: I'll run the 200-sample eval and post results in the thread. If semantic delta < 1.5% we ship canary.

asha_cse: Client sync scheduled 2026-03-25 10:00 PT — will propose the canary + cache plan and show estimated cost delta (~-28% per token for short queries).

elaine_cs: Perfect. Action items: @miguel_se -> evaluation harness, @riley_ml -> prepare model artifact and route config, @asha_cse -> client approval + top-20 template list. I'll follow up after the eval. :thumbsup:
